checks.default_logo: Redesigned transparent RGBA SaaS logo applied through audited branding service; PNG metadata and app startup verified

browser.latest_live_check: Restarted app redirects to working sign-in; authenticated tree rendering verified by Django tests, not browser visual inspection

limitations: Live OpenAI/Claude/GitHub calls not validated; credentials required. SDK provider calls use test doubles. Claude bundled CLI version check passed.

Code Factory delivers a draft pull request that replaces files it first read and creates paths the approved plan named that are not there; deleting a file is refused, and no build or test suite is run.
Embedding retrieval, semantic entailment scoring, Graphify integration, and scheduled or write-back connector operations pending.
Code Graph reads GitHub only; a run pins one snapshot. Chat cannot read Code Graph at all.
Correctness depends on a single worker process: the stream registry and the API rate limit are process-local.
PostgreSQL concurrency/RLS, SSO/MFA and disaster recovery not validated

documents.upload: Multi-file upload: up to 20 files / 20 MiB total; arbitrary original types accepted
documents.authorization: owner/contributor upload; explicit application grant required
documents.formats: All types accepted; successful conversion depends on MarkItDown support
documents.production_intake: disabled pending scanner and private storage integration
documents.processing: Automatic durable local queue, offline MarkItDown 0.1.7 conversion, 45-second timeout, 1M Markdown character limit
documents.deletion: Owner or uploading contributor; confirmation, original removal, Knowledge removal, audit event
documents.graph_input: Scoped Markdown and JSON exports with source/Markdown fingerprints

navigation: One Knowledge menu with Graph, Sources, Quality and Versions subviews; Documents retains uploads/deletion

graph.generation: Automatic structural graph plus opt-in selected-provider semantic enrichment; bounded evidence validation and version metadata
graph.view: Interactive SVG, node search, source evidence, JSON export
graph.quality: Source and structural coverage, provenance, empty cells, duplicate rows, isolated nodes; semantic accuracy not measured
graph.security: Application-scoped IDs/access; stale graph content withheld immediately
graph.versioning: Numbered persisted snapshots; current snapshot preserved as v1; per-version views/quality/exports; unavailable if sources removed or changed
graph.rendering_fix: CSP explicitly allows same-origin external scripts; inline/eval remain disallowed
graph.retrieval: Graph endpoint/relation matching and one-hop expansion, up to eight source citations, selected graph retrieval model
graph.failure_policy: No automatic retry of failed/interrupted AI calls; explicit retry available
graph.drift: The published revision's drift from its sources is counted and shown on the Versions tab and the chat header; it is never enforced, because answering from a snapshot is the point

chat.history: Persisted conversations scoped to current user and application; legacy history migration tested
chat.context: Up to 8 prior turns; removed/changed sources excluded; follow-up lexical retrieval
chat.presentation: Chronological messages, safe Markdown subset, collapsed sources, sending status, preserved error drafts
chat.validation: 637 tests passed; default AI routing, greetings without evidence, missing-setup/no-fallback behavior verified with mocked provider
chat.llm: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.2 and Claude Agent SDK 0.2.152; independent per-application/per-task provider/model; two scoped knowledge tools (search_knowledge, fetch_source), bounded to four model turns and eight tool calls; every built-in provider tool disabled
chat.default: AI mode; Sources mode requires explicit selection; visible missing model/key status
chat.local_configuration_status: MQACEKnowledge: no AI configuration or mounted OpenAI/Claude key file at diagnosis; live LLM connection not verified
chat.api: POST /api/v1/applications/<id>/chat/ answers with the application's own model; JSON, or 202 plus an SSE stream_url with "stream": true. Server-side conversations scoped to the token's user. Gated on the opt-in chat_api feature switch, off for every application until an owner enables it - the only API surface that spends a provider budget.

connectors.kinds: GitHub issues, Jira issues, ServiceNow table records
connectors.bounds: 100 most recently updated records per import, deduplicated by digest
connectors.schedule: manual only; nothing imports on a timer and nothing is written back to the tracker

code_graph.scope: GitHub only; the remote host is hardcoded and no URL is accepted
code_graph.indexing: clone at the resolved commit, index files/symbols/imports, delete the checkout; 500 files, 400 KB per file, 20 MiB total
code_graph.consumers: Code Factory analysis and design only; chat cannot read it

code_factory.pipeline: triage, analysis, design, human approval, implementation, verification, delivery
code_factory.gates: a different user with can_approve must approve; the repository must be confirmed; a github_write_<application> credential distinct from the read credential must be mounted
code_factory.delivery: draft pull request on a digital-brain/ branch; replaces files it first read at the base branch and creates approved paths GitHub reports as absent, re-checked still absent before writing and committed without a blob sha; 20 files, 400 KB each; no deletion or merge
code_factory.outcome: not read back - merge state and CI results are not recorded
code_factory.creation: a path counts as new only on a 404, never on an unreadable read; the path comes from a plan item a second person approved, and the implementing model addresses files by number and cannot name a path
